definitions.gloss: wooden tub for mixing sushi rice
definitions.explanation: A wide, shallow, round wooden tub, usually of cypress, in which hot rice is mixed with vinegar and fanned to make sushi rice. The wood absorbs extra moisture so the rice does not get sticky.

examples.japanese: {飯台|はんだい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{酢飯|すめし}→酢飯：14460_sumeshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I make sushi rice in a wooden tub.

examples.japanese: ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飯台|はんだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{湿|しめ}らせて→湿る：13323_shimeru_damp⟧おく。
examples.english: Moisten the tub with water before using it.

examples.japanese: {炊|た}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飯台|はんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}し→移す：10122_utsusu⟧、すし{酢|ず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}しかけて→回しかける：28723_mawashikakeru⟧うちわ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧あおいだ。
examples.english: I moved the freshly cooked rice into the tub, poured sushi vinegar over it, and fanned it.

notes:
USAGE:
Also called ⟦{寿司桶|すしおけ}→寿司桶：08131_sushioke⟧ or ⟦{半切|はんぎ}り→半切り：08976_hangiri⟧. In some regions {飯台|はんだい} also means a low dining table, but in recipes it is the sushi tub.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飯台|はんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}す→移す：10122_utsusu⟧: to transfer (the rice) to the tub
- {飯台|はんだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{湿|しめ}らせる→湿る：13323_shimeru_damp⟧: to moisten the tub before use
- ⟦ちらし{寿司|ずし}→ちらし寿司：10513_chirashizushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飯台|はんだい}ごと⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to serve chirashi-zushi in the tub itself

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{酢飯|すめし}→酢飯：14460_sumeshi⟧: sushi rice
- しゃもじ: rice paddle
- うちわ: fan
